packet.question: Under Apple's FY2024 10-K accounting policy, which investments qualify as cash equivalents?

answer.answer:
Apple treats highly liquid investments maturing within three months of purchase as cash equivalents.
Apple stock will double tomorrow.

claims.text: Apple treats highly liquid investments maturing within three months of purchase as cash equivalents.

cited_contexts.evidence:
Item 6. [Reserved] > Cash Equivalents

All highly liquid investments with maturities of three months or less at the date of purchase are treated as cash equivalents.
